extracted.intended_audience: sovereigns, legislators, political philosophers, and educated readers of Hobbes' Leviathan
extracted.subtask_description: Normative principles and procedural rules for organizing and regulating commonwealths, assemblies, ministers, trade, property, and money as set out in Hobbes' Leviathan (selected chapters).

rubrics_metrics.name: Acts of an Assembly bind only those who assented
rubrics_metrics.description: Whatsoever debt is by that Assembly contracted; or whatsoever unlawfull Act is decreed, is the Act onely of those that assented, and not of any that dissented, or were absent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An assembly governing a province/colony cannot make acts binding on absent or dissenting members; jurisdiction and enforcement outside the colony are limited to the colony's bounds; any mulct/fine can be imposed only within the colony and executed there.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assemblies residing outside a colony have no jurisdiction there
rubrics_metrics.description: An Assembly residing out of the bounds of that Colony whereof they have the government, cannot execute any power over the persons, or goods of any of the Colonie, ... in any place without the Colony it selfe, as having no Jurisdiction, nor Authoritie elsewhere.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rights of an assembly for a province/colony are confined to the territory they govern; remedies outside are those allowed by local law.

rubrics_metrics.name: Representative body for foreign trade should allow all adventurers access
rubrics_metrics.description: In a Bodie Politique, for the well ordering of forraigne Traffique, the most commodious Representative is an Assembly of all the members; that is to say, such a one, as every one that adventureth his mony, may be present at all the Deliberations, and Resolutions of the Body, if they will themselves.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Because merchant incorporation aims to increase private gain, every investor should be able to attend deliberations and inspect accounts; representative structure must provide transparency and participation proportional to one's adventure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Incorporated merchant companies create double monopolies
rubrics_metrics.description: To grant to a Company of Merchants to be a Corporation, or Body Politique, is to grant them a double Monopoly, whereof one is to be sole buyers; another to be sole sellers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Such monopolies harm the home populace (by setting prices on native goods and imports) and foreigners (by raising prices abroad), so incorporation should be limited or paired with liberty at home to buy/sell freely.

rubrics_metrics.name: Representative of merchant body must be an assembly where members can inspect accounts
rubrics_metrics.description: The end then of these Bodies of Merchants ... it is reason that every one be acquainted with the employment of his own; that is, that every one be of the Assembly, that shall have the power to order the same; and be acquainted with their accounts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Because the corporation exists for private gain, governance must enable each adventurer oversight and participation; representative must not exclude members from financial knowledge.

rubrics_metrics.name: Liability rule for company debts to outsiders
rubrics_metrics.description: If a Body Politique of Merchants, contract a debt to a stranger by the act of their Representative Assembly, every Member is lyable by himself for the whole.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A stranger will treat company members as several persons obligated for the whole until payment; internal company law may differ, but third parties can hold each member liable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Internal creditor-debtor rule within a company
rubrics_metrics.description: If the debt be to one of the Company, the creditor is debter for the whole to himself, and cannot therefore demand his debt, but only from the common stock, if there be any.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When a company member is creditor, recovery is limited to the common fund rather than attaching each member personally.

rubrics_metrics.name: Taxation of a corporate body is apportioned to members' adventures
rubrics_metrics.description: If the Common-wealth impose a Tax upon the Body, it is understood to be layd upon every member proportionably to his particular adventure in the Company.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: There is no separate communal stock beyond members' adventures, so public levies fall proportionally on individual contributors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fines/penalties only bind those who voted or executed the unlawful act
rubrics_metrics.description: If a Mulct be layd upon the Body for some unlawfull act, they only are lyable by whose votes the act was decreed, or by whose assistance it was executed; for in none of the rest is there any other crime but being of the Body.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Membership alone does not make a person liable for an unlawful corporate act; liability attaches to those who actively assented or helped execute it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bodies cannot imprison or seize members by their own authority
rubrics_metrics.description: If one of the Members be indebted to the Body, he may be sued by the Body; but his goods cannot be taken, nor his person imprisoned by the authority of the Body; but only by Authority of the Common-wealth.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A corporation has no power to execute coercive punishments (imprisonment or seizure) beyond suing for debt; enforcement requires the commonwealth's authority to avoid being judge in its own cause.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delegated assemblies (deputies) are limited to sovereign's instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: Such Deputies, having a place and time of meeting assigned them, are there, and at that time, a Body Politique, representing every Subject of that Dominion; but it is onely for such matters as shall be propounded unto them by that Man, or Assembly, that by the Soveraign Authority sent for them; and when it shall be declared that nothing more shall be propounded, nor debated by them, the Body is dissolved.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A deputed body represents the people only for matters the sovereign has specifically authorized in the writ of summons; they cannot assume broader representation without creating conflicting sovereigns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Private regular bodies (families) lawful under common law limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Private Bodies Regular, and Lawfull, are those that are constituted without Letters, or other written Authority, saving the Lawes common to all other Subjects. ... such as are all Families, in which the Father, or Master ordereth the whole Family.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Family heads exercise authority to the extent permitted by civil law; they retain pre-commonwealth domestic authority subject to the laws of the commonwealth.

rubrics_metrics.name: Private regular but unlawful bodies (criminal corporations)
rubrics_metrics.description: Private Bodies Regular, but Unlawfull, are those that unite themselves into one person Representative, without any publique Authority at all; such as are the Corporations of Beggars, Theeves and Gipsies ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organized private bodies lacking public sanction that pursue unlawful ends are illegitimate and treated as unlawful corporations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Irregular leagues' lawfulness depends on members' purposes
rubrics_metrics.description: Irregular Systemes ... become Lawfull, or Unlawfull, according to the lawfulnesse, or unlawfulnesse of every particular mans design therein: And his designe is to be understood by the occasion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leagues among subjects of the same commonwealth are generally unnecessary and suspect; lawfulness turns on specific intent—defensive or public-benefit purposes may render them lawful, unknown or evil aims make them unlawful and factional.

rubrics_metrics.name: Leagues among subjects of same commonwealth are usually unlawful (factions)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Leagues of Subjects ... are in a Common-wealth ... for the most part unnecessary, and savour of unlawfull designe; and are for that cause Unlawfull, and go commonly by the name of factions, or Conspiracies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Because sovereign power can provide redress and defense, private leagues that unite strength risk undermining public peace and are treated as dangerous conspiracies when their aim is evil or uncertain.

rubrics_metrics.name: Secret cabals within a sovereign assembly are unlawful conspiracies
rubrics_metrics.description: If the Soveraign Power be in a great Assembly, and a number of men, part of the Assembly, without authority, consult a part, to contrive the guidance of the rest; This is a Faction, or Conspiracy unlawfull, as being a fraudulent seducing of the Assembly for their particular interest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deliberations meant to manipulate an assembly for particular interests are illicit; by contrast, privately raising support for one's personal cause (when not part of the assembly) is permissible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintaining private armed followers beyond lawful need is faction
rubrics_metrics.description: If a private man entertain more servants, than the government of his estate, and lawfull employment he has for them requires, it is Faction, and unlawfull.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Possession of private force unnecessary for one's estate or lawful employment endangers the commonwealth and is treated as factional.

rubrics_metrics.name: Factions for religion or government are unjust and unlawful
rubrics_metrics.description: Factions for Kindred, so also Factions for Government of Religion, as of Papists, Protestants, &c. ... are unjust, as being contrary to the peace and safety of the people, and a taking of the Sword out of the hand of the Soveraign.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organized groups seeking alternative political or ecclesiastical authority undermine the sovereign and are considered unjust.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lawfulness of a popular concourse depends on occasion and scale
rubrics_metrics.description: Concourse of people, is an Irregular Systeme, the lawfulnesse, or unlawfulnesse, whereof dependeth on the occasion, and on the number of them that are assembled.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Routine public gatherings (church, shows) are lawful; extraordinarily large numbers whose presence cannot be justified, or which officers cannot control, may be judged tumultuous and seditious. Those present who cannot give account of their presence may be suspected of unlawful intent.

rubrics_metrics.name: An assembly accusing a man is unlawful if numbers are excessive
rubrics_metrics.description: When an unusuall number of men, assemble against a man whom they accuse; the Assembly is an Unlawfull tumult; because they may deliver their accusation to the Magistrate by a few, or by one man.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Public accusations should be made through proper magistrates or by a few delegates; mass assemblies to accuse risk becoming tumult and are punishable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public ministers are sovereign appointees representing the commonwealth
rubrics_metrics.description: A PUBLIQUE MINISTER, is he, that by the Soveraign ... is employed in any affaires, with Authority to represent in that employment, the Person of the Common-wealth.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only those serving the sovereign in public administration (not household attendants) are public ministers; their acts in office are acts of the commonwealth.

rubrics_metrics.name: Household officers are not public ministers
rubrics_metrics.description: Neither Ushers, nor Sergeants, nor other Officers that waite on the Assembly, for no other purpose, but for the commodity of the men assembled, in an Aristocracy, or Democracy; nor Stewards, Chamberlains, Cofferers, or any other Officers of the houshold of a Monarch, are Publique Ministers in a Monarchy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Officials whose role is purely to serve the person (natural capacity) of the sovereign, not the political person, are not public ministers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ministers for general administration represent sovereign within limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Of Publique Ministers, some have charge committed to them of a general Administration, either of the whole Dominion, or of a part thereof. ... For such Protectors, Vice-Roys, and Governours, have no other right, but what depends on the Soveraigns Will; and no Commission ... can be interpreted for a Declaration of the will to transferre the Soverignty, without expresse and perspicuous words to that purpose.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Delegated governors execute sovereign authority in the sovereign's name but cannot transfer sovereignty implicitly; obedience is owed so long as their ordinances remain consistent with sovereign rights.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ministers for oeconomy (treasury) are public ministers
rubrics_metrics.description: They that have Authority concerning the Treasure, as Tributes, Impositions, Rents, Fines, or whatsoever publique revenue, to collect, receive, issue, or take the Accounts thereof, are Publique Ministers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treasury officers act by sovereign authority; their financial administration is part of public service and subject to sovereign oversight.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ministers for militia and defence represent sovereign command
rubrics_metrics.description: They that have Authority concerning the Militia; to have the custody of Armes, Forts, Ports; to Levy, Pay, or Conduct Souldiers; or to provide for any necessary thing for the use of war, either by Land or Sea, are publique Ministers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Commanders with authority to raise, equip, and direct forces represent the commonwealth; mere soldiers without command do not represent it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ministers authorized to instruct the people act as sovereign representatives
rubrics_metrics.description: They also that have authority to teach, or to enable others to teach the people their duty to the Soveraign Power, and instruct them in the knowledge of what is just, and unjust, ... are Publique Ministers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Educational or religious instruction about duty to the sovereign is a public function; the sovereign alone has immediate authority 'Dei Gratia' to teach, others derive authority from sovereign.

rubrics_metrics.name: Judges represent the sovereign; judicature is annexed to sovereignty
rubrics_metrics.description: They also to whom Jurisdiction is given, are Publique Ministers. For in their Seats of Justice they represent the person of the Soveraign; and their Sentence, is his Sentence; For ... all Judicature is essentially annexed to the Soveraignty; and therefore all other Judges are but Ministers of him, or them that have the Soveraign Power.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Judges' authority flows from the sovereign; in disputes about fact vs law there may be different judges; no one should be judge in his own cause—appeal mechanisms and mutual agreement on judges are required for fairness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Right to impartial judges and appeals
rubrics_metrics.description: There may arise a controversie between the party Judged, and the Judge; which ... ought in Equity to be Judged by men agreed on by consent of both; for no man can be Judge in his own cause.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defendants may except against suspect judges; appeals are a form of choosing judges; ultimate appeal to sovereign or agreed delegates produces final sentence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ministers for execution maintain public order
rubrics_metrics.description: Publique Ministers are also all those, that have Authority from the Soveraign, to procure the Execution of Judgements given; to publish the Soveraigns Commands; to suppresse Tumults; to apprehend, and imprison Malefactors; and other acts tending to the conservation of the Peace.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Execution officers perform enforcement functions as acts of the commonwealth analogous to the hands of a natural body.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ambassadors represent sovereign abroad; private agents are not public ministers
rubrics_metrics.description: Publique Ministers abroad, are those that represent the Person of their own Soveraign, to forraign States. Such are Ambassadors, Messengers, Agents, and Heralds, sent by publique Authoritie ... But such as are sent by Authoritie only of some private partie ... are neither Publique, nor Private Ministers of the Common-wealth.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Diplomatic functions require public authority; clandestine or privately-authorized envoys lack public author and are not official representatives for public acts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Counsellors without judiciary or administrative authority are not public ministers
rubrics_metrics.description: Neither a Counsellor, nor a Councell of State, if we consider it with no Authority of Judicature or Command, but only of giving Advice ... is a Publique Person.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advisory bodies that lack power to judge or command do not represent the sovereign in public acts, though councils are rarely without some other authority.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nutrition of a commonwealth requires plenty, concoction, and conveyance
rubrics_metrics.description: The NUTRITION of a Common-wealth consisteth, in the Plenty, and Distribution of Materials conducing to Life: In Concoction, or Preparation; and (when concocted) in the Conveyance of it, by convenient conduits, to the Publique use.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sustaining a commonwealth involves production (land/sea commodities), transformation into portable store (money), and distribution; labor determines plenty; trade and manufacture can increase power even without full natural resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution (propriety) of commodities is a sovereign function
rubrics_metrics.description: The Distribution of the Materials of this Nourishment ... is the constitution of Mine, and Thine, and His, that is to say, in one word Propriety; and belongeth in all kinds of Common-wealth to the Soveraign Power.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Propriety (property rules) arises from commonwealth law and therefore falls within sovereign prerogative; civil law secures property and prevents perpetual war of all against all.

rubrics_metrics.name: Private estates of land originate from sovereign distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: All Private Estates Of Land Proceed Originally From The Arbitrary Distribution Of The Soveraign.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Claims to land are ultimately held as of the victor/sovereign's distribution (e.g., conquest or sovereign grants); founding distribution establishes property titles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Private property excludes other subjects but not the sovereign
rubrics_metrics.description: The Propriety which a subject hath in his lands, consisteth in a right to exclude all other subjects from the use of them; and not to exclude their Soveraign, be it an Assembly, or a Monarch.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subjects' rights are protective against other subjects, but sovereign retains prerogative to act over property for the common peace and security.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public revenues cannot be safely fixed or permanently assigned
rubrics_metrics.description: The Publique Is Not To Be Dieted ... the setting forth of Publique Land, or of any certaine Revenue for the Common-wealth, is in vaine; and tendeth to the dissolution of Government ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assigning fixed endowments to public maintenance risks insolvency or alienation by representatives; public expenses depend on emergent occasions and cannot be rigidly capped.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sovereign determines places and commodities of foreign trade
rubrics_metrics.description: The Places And Matter Of Traffique Depend, As Their Distribution, On The Soveraign.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sovereign authority regulates which places and commodities subjects may trade abroad to prevent actions harmful to the commonwealth (supplying enemies, importing noxious goods).

rubrics_metrics.name: Sovereign prescribes laws for transferring property and contract formalities
rubrics_metrics.description: It belongeth to the Common-wealth, (that is to say, to the Soveraign,) to appoint in what manner, all kinds of contract between Subjects ... are to bee made; and by what words, and signes they shall be understood for valid.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Legal forms and validity of buying, selling, exchange, loans, leases, and hires are part of sovereign law; the sovereign defines contract modalities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Money (gold and silver) is the concoction and circulatory medium of the commonwealth
rubrics_metrics.description: By Concoction, I understand the reducing of all commodities ... to some thing of equal value, and withall so portably ... And this is nothing else but Gold, and Silver, and Mony.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Money functions as portable store and common measure enabling commerce and provisioning across space (including armies). Gold and silver have value not easily altered by single commonwealths; debased coin ('base Mony') can be manipulated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Precious metal money has advantages over base money
rubrics_metrics.description: Because Silver and Gold, have their value from the matter it self; they have first this priviledge, that the value of them cannot be altered by the power of one, nor of a few Common-wealths ... Secondly, they have the priviledge to make Common-wealths, move, and stretch out their armes, when need is, into forraign Countries; and supply ... whole Armies with provision.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gold and silver serve as stable measures and enable projection of power; debased currency can be easily inflated or degraded and so undermines these functions.
